question: Which fort is built on the bank of Chenab river?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Akhnoor fort**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Akhnoor Fort is on Chenab River's right bank (formerly named Asikni).
 
• Construction was initiated in 1762 CE by Raja Tegh Singh and completed in 1802 by his successor, Raja Alam Singh.
 
• Maharaja Ranjeet Singh crowned Maharaja Gulab Singh on Jia Pota ghat at the fort on Chenab's riverbank on 17th June 1822.
